verdict.rationale: TrueLayer is a payments platform with configurable recurring flows (mandates, sweeping), so asking about managing automations is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of automations or configurations. The mandate, sweeping, webhook and MCP items describe other capabilities and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
